post.text:
🚨My name is Carlos Giménez.

I am the only Member of Congress born in #Cuba & I fully support President Trump’s actions against the regime in Havana.

It would ABSOLUTELY be a great honor for the President to take the island & liberate it! 🇺🇸🇨🇺 https://t.co/UpI3cw4xRC
post.author_description: U.S. Congressman | Armed Services, Homeland Security, & Select Committee on China | Vice-Chair of RG2 | Firefighter & Mayor of Miami-Dade #FL28

description.description: A close-up of Donald Trump sitting at his desk in the Oval Office, looking to the side and talking.

tweetMedia.transcription: I think Cuba, I don't know, in its own way, if you're, you know, tourism and everything else, it's a beautiful island, great weather. They're not in a hurricane zone, which is nice for a change, you know. They won't be asking us for money for hurricanes every week. But I think Cuba's seeing the end. You know, all my life I've been hearing about the United States and Cuba. When will the United States do it? I do believe I'll be the honor of having the honor of taking Cuba. that's a big honor taking Cuba in some form whether I free it take it I can do anything I want with it they're a very weakened nation they were for a long time very violent leaders
